scope: All default readers, aliases, explicit raw input, format discovery, source types/headers, subformats, compression and stack semantics. No format-level parity claim without independent fixtures. Write/conversion APIs are out of scope.

outer_file_compression.implementation: optional wrappers feature: magic-detected gzip/bzip2, bounded temporary staging, original-source checks; native/EDF/CBF/TIFF; HDF5 and direct file-like APIs pending

cross_cutting_targets.file_series: pending explicit series API; numbered neighboring files must not be silently substituted
cross_cutting_targets.autodetection: pending; current backends are explicitly selected by caller
cross_cutting_targets.orientation: return stored rows/columns and metadata; consumer transformations are explicit
cross_cutting_targets.source_mutation: immutable snapshots check normal filesystem changes; no adversarial metadata-preserving writes or live refresh
cross_cutting_targets.header_coverage: raw EDF/CBF/native headers, parsed native fields and typed TIFF tags; typed HDF5 shape/dtype/endian/filter/fill/source metadata and selected discovery fields; arbitrary attributes and complete semantic detector header maps pending

formats.subformats_and_types: EDF 0/1/2/3; concatenated frames; general headers; inline/external binary; 2D/volume; integer/float aliases including optional float128
formats.compression: none; internal gzip/zlib/bzip2; optional byte-offset; outer gzip/bzip2
formats.implementation: partial: inline 2D, ten scalar types, both byte orders, none/gzip/zlib/bzip2 aliases, optional uncompressed Size and binary padding; general/external/volume/float128/offset pending; outer wrappers via wrapped::Reader

formats.subformats_and_types: d*TREK / ADSC; Rigaku 1.1; endian scalar data and text header
formats.implementation: partial: seven scalar types, both byte orders, nested-brace headers, legacy ADSC TYPE alias, raw padded headers; 1D/volume and permissive missing-type defaults pending
